spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Naes casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 18}):

action.name: Mace
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) radiant damage.

action.name: Corona of Beauty
entries: Naes activates an aura of sunlight that lasts for 1 minute or until he dismisses it using an action. He emits bright light in a 60-foot-radius and dim light 30 feet beyond that. His enemies in the bright light have disadvantage on saving throws against any spell that deals fire or radiant damage.

action.name: Radiant Beauty of Sune {@recharge 4}
entries: Naes dispels any magical darkness within 30 feet of him. Additionally, each hostile creature within 30 feet of Naes that does not have {@quickref Cover||3||total cover} must make a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw, taking 60 radiant damage on a failed saving throw, half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that fails the saving throw has the {@condition blinded} condition for 1 minute.

reaction.name: Hard to Kill (1/Day)
entries: If Naes would drop to 0 hit points as a result of taking damage, or is subjected to an effect that would kill him instantaneously without doing damage, Naes instead drops to 1 hit point.
